description: Resets the funnel analytics of one webinar, for example after test registrations polluted the numbers. `scope` window reopens only the current show window, lifetime wipes all daily and touch statistics. Side effect: the numbers are gone from the site and cannot be restored; registrants, emails and the campaign itself are NOT touched. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `scope` and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Say which of the two scopes it is and what is lost before you write, and read the numbers with wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats before and after.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that these numbers may be reset.

scope.description: window reopens the current show window, lifetime wipes all statistics of this webinar.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_reset_webinar_funnel
title: Reset the funnel numbers of a webinar
